panel.evidence: The migration adds only the column; no `CREATE INDEX` on `"Document"("updatedAt")` and schema.prisma has no `@@index`. Both list endpoints now sort by it (packages/backend/src/document/document.controller.ts:116,148), and `touchUpdatedAt` (packages/backend/src/document/document.service.ts:120) issues an `updateMany` per edit webhook, so read+write volume on this column grows with edit traffic.

coderabbit.summary: Use a past date in the `issuedAt` test to avoid time-dependent failures.
coderabbit.detail: **Use a past date in the `issuedAt` test to avoid time-dependent failures.** The test expects `touchUpdatedAt` to be called with `new Date('2026-07-10T06:03:13.331Z')`, but the controller clamps `issuedAt` to `now()` via `Math.min(issuedMs, now)`. If the test executes before that exact UTC moment, the clamp kicks in and `touchUpdatedAt` receives `now()` instead — causing a flaky failure. Using a clearly historical date eliminates this fragility.
